pages.lesson:
LESSON: COMMON

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: LISTENING
Topic 2.1: Common

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Common. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Common
2. Practise Common at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Common

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Common
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Common. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Common at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Common at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Common
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Common. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Common using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Common in the examples.
2. Explain Common to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Common.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Common using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Common important for a PP2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Be encouraged to respond to visitors and family members’ greetings and farewell at home with reference to relationship using appropriate words.
2. View recorded clips on responding to greetings and farewell with reference to relationship and imitate the same. 3
3. Learners role play responding to greetings and farewell with reference to relationship.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Common
2. Practise Common at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Common

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
